data.one_liner: Change your Flutter app launcher icon at runtime on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to dynamically change their launcher icon at runtime for branding, themes, or feature switches. It supports auto-discovery of icons and offers options for iOS alert suppression and Android background deferral.
use_when: You want to offer dark/light or seasonal alternate app icons to users.
Your app requires dynamic branding updates or feature-based icon switching.
avoid_when: You do not want to configure native activity aliases in AndroidManifest.xml or Info.plist.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS out of the box.
Provides auto-discovery of available icons from configuration.
Includes Android background deferral to prevent OEM launcher disruptions.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in both AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
iOS icon alert suppression relies on a private API which may break in future iOS versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding activity aliases to AndroidManifest.xml along with density-specific icon assets, and configuring CFBundleAlternateIcons and CFBundlePrimaryIcon in iOS Info.plist.
